headline: No business was conducted because too few members attended to form a quorum.
summary: Four members attended and three were absent. A motion to adjourn passed 3-0, ending the session.
plain_text:
Leach Library Board of Trustees
Draft Meeting minutes
October 27, 2026 at 7:00 PM
Leach Library, Londonderry NH
Members Present:
 Nancy Hendricks, Chair
 Beth Marrocco, Vice-Chair
 Erica Laue, Secretary
 Donna Plante, Interim Library Director
Members Absent:
 Azra Palo, Treasurer
 Moira Ryan, Trustee
 Jan McLaughlin, Trustee
Call to Order: made by Chair Hendricks at 7 PM.
No business conducted due to a lack of quorum.
Adjournment: motion made by Secretary Laue at 7:03 PM, seconded by Vice Chair 
Marrocco. Motion passes 3-0.
Minutes prepared by Secretary Laue.
